messages:
maya: FYI Orchid experienced another brief isolation on a dedicated cluster at 08:12 UTC. Symptoms match the stale VPC peering + reload race we've tracked. Draft postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/orchid-dedicated-isolation-draft. Need owners and a short remediation timeline.

liam: saw it. I'll own peering hardening (route validation + TTL + health probe). Quick target: canary in staging by Fri. Will add telemetry metric peer_stale_count.

sophia: I'll take the reload/race side (iptables/systemd-networkd timing). Need staging access to reproduce; @maya can you grant? I have a repro plan in the doc.

devin: I'll handle alert tuning and the runbook updates. Proposed alert change: isolate_incidents > 3 in 1h -> pager. Also creating a weekly "isolation-sweep" for 6 weeks.

maya: Staging access granted. Security gave a thumbs-up. Timeline suggestion: patch in staging Thu, canary Fri, rollout Mon. Weekly check-ins Wed 17:00Z x6.

infra-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-1543. Severity: P2. First alert: 2026-03-22T08:12:01Z. Logs: /incidents/INC-2026-1543/logs.tar.gz

liam: ops tip: to spot stale peers: `ssh jump@orchid-staging -- sudo ip route show proto static | grep peer`. I'll add a watchdog script to surface anomalies to the new metric.

sophia: reproduced the race in staging with the repro steps. Opening PR now: fix/iptables-reload-guard. Requesting net-eng review.

maya: Action items (summary): 1) liam 60; peering hardening (ETA 2026-03-27). 2) sophia 60; reload-guard PR (ETA 2026-03-26). 3) devin 60; alert tuning + invite + runbook (ETA 2026-03-24). 4) maya 60; customer comms + finalize postmortem (ETA 2026-03-25). Please ack. :white_check_mark:

liam: ack :thumbsup:

devin: ack, filing tickets and invite now.

sophia: ack, PR opened and flagged for review.

maya: Added tracker ORB-439 and linked the canary playbook. If blockers show up, post here and I'll escalate.

devin: note for recurrence policy: if >2 isolations of this class in 30d -> cross-team task force (eng-runtime + infra + platform). I'll add a tracker badge to automate escalation.

liam: post-PR test checklist: 1) 24h canary peering 2) peer_stale_count == 0 for 24h 3) no new isolate_incidents alerts.

sophia: will run kernel experiments in canary and post results to tracker.

maya: thanks, team. I'll update the postmortem and notify Orchid support.
